help.moderation.label: 🛡️ Moderation
help.moderation.title: 🛡️ Moderation
help.moderation.f1.name: 🚫 Sanctions
help.moderation.f1.value:
`/kick @membre [raison]` — Kicks a member
`/ban @membre [durée] [raison]` — Bans a member
`/unban user_id` — Unbans a user
`/mute @membre durée [raison]` — Times out a member
`/unmute @membre` — Removes the timeout
help.moderation.f2.name: ⚠️ Warnings
help.moderation.f2.value:
`/warn @membre raison` — Adds a warning
`/unwarn id` — Removes a warning
`/warnings @membre` — View warnings
`/clearwarnings @membre` — Clears all warnings
`/history @membre` — Full sanction history
help.moderation.f3.name: 🧹 Messages & Channels
help.moderation.f3.value:
`/clear [nombre] [membre] [bots] [images] [contient]`
`/slowmode [secondes]` — Slow mode
`/lock [raison]` — Locks the channel
`/unlock [raison]` — Unlocks the channel
help.automod.label: 🤖 Auto-Mod & Anti-Raid
help.automod.title: 🤖 Auto-Moderation & Anti-Raid
help.automod.desc: Automatic protection against spam, raids, and abuse.
help.automod.f1.name: 🔇 Auto-Moderation
help.automod.f1.value:
`/automod status` — View config
`/automod toggle` — Enable/disable
`/automod spam <max> <secs>` — Anti-spam
`/automod flood <max> <secs>` — Anti-flood
`/automod invites on/off` — Block invites
`/automod links on/off` — Block all links
`/automod linkwhitelist domaine` — Allowed domain
`/automod caps <pct>` — Limit caps
`/automod mentions <max>` — Limit mentions
`/automod bypass @role` — Exempt role
help.automod.f2.name: 🛡️ Anti-Raid
help.automod.f2.value:
`/antiraid status` — View config
`/antiraid toggle` — Enable/disable
`/antiraid config <joins> <secs>` — Detection threshold
`/antiraid lockdown` — Emergency server lockdown
`/antiraid unlock` — Reopen the server
help.automod.f3.name: 👻 Ghost Pings
help.automod.f3.value:
`/ghostping true/false` — Enable ghost ping detection
*(Automatic log if a ping is deleted within < 30 seconds)*
help.xp.label: ⭐ XP & Levels
help.xp.title: ⭐ XP & Levels System
help.xp.desc: Progression based on chat activity. 15–25 XP per message (60s cooldown).
help.xp.f1.name: 📊 View
help.xp.f1.value:
`/rank [@membre]` — View your rank and XP
`/leaderboard` — Server XP leaderboard
help.xp.f2.name: ⚙️ Administration
help.xp.f2.value:
`/setxp @membre quantité` — Set XP
`/addxp @membre quantité` — Add XP
`/resetxp @membre` — Reset XP
help.xp.f3.name: 🏆 Level roles
help.xp.f3.value:
`/xprole add <niveau> @role` — Role for a level tier
`/xprole remove <niveau>` — Remove a tier
`/xprole list` — View all tiers
help.tickets.label: 🎫 Tickets
help.tickets.title: 🎫 Ticket System
help.tickets.desc: Create and manage support tickets with categories.
help.tickets.f1.name: ⚙️ Configuration
help.tickets.f1.value:
`/ticket setup <categorie> [staff]` — Set up
`/ticket categories` — Manage categories
`/ticket couleur <hex>` — Embed color
`/ticket message` — Send the opening panel
`/ticket customize` — Channel name format and buttons
help.tickets.f2.name: 🎛️ Managing a ticket
help.tickets.f2.value:
`/tadd @membre` — Add a member
`/tremove @membre` — Remove a member
`/tclaim` — Claim the ticket
`/tunclaim` — Release the ticket
help.roles.label: 🎭 Roles
help.roles.title: 🎭 Reaction Roles & Auto-Sanctions
help.roles.desc: Automatic role assignment via buttons, and scheduled sanctions.
help.roles.f1.name: 🎭 Reaction roles
help.roles.f1.value:
`/rr create <titre> [description]` — Create a panel
`/rr add <panel_id> @role [label] [emoji]` — Add a role
`/rr remove <panel_id> @role` — Remove a role
`/rr delete <panel_id>` — Delete the panel
`/rr list` — List panels
help.roles.f2.name: 🤖 Auto-Sanctions
help.roles.f2.value:
`/autosanction add <warns> <action> [durée]` — Add a tier
`/autosanction remove <warns>` — Remove a tier
`/autosanction list` — View all tiers

**Actions:** `mute` `kick` `ban` `tempban`
help.vocal.label: 🎙️ Temporary Voice
help.vocal.title: 🎙️ Temporary Voice Channels
help.vocal.desc: Join the trigger channel → a voice channel is automatically created with a control panel **built directly into it**.
help.vocal.f1.name: ⚙️ Configuration (Admin)
help.vocal.f1.value:
`/tempvoice setup <déclencheur> [catégorie]` — Set up
`/tempvoice config [format] [limite]` — Name format and limit
`/tempvoice status` — View configuration

**Format:** `{user}` = member's nickname
help.vocal.f2.name: 🎛️ Control panel (in the channel)
help.vocal.f2.value:
🔒 **Lock** — Lock access
👁️ **Hide** — Hide the channel
🔐 **Private** — Lock + Hide simultaneously
✏️ **Rename** — Change the name
👥 **Limit** — Set the max member count
👑 **Transfer** — Give away ownership
➕ **Allow** — Invite someone (private mode)
🚫 **Kick** — Kick a member from the channel
🗑️ **Delete** — Close the channel

help.embeds.title: 🖼️ Embed Builder
help.embeds.desc: Create rich messages with custom buttons (links, roles, messages).
help.embeds.f1.name: 📝 Commands
help.embeds.f1.value:

help.giveaways.title: 🎉 Giveaways

help.starboard_afk.label: ⭐ Starboard & AFK
help.starboard_afk.title: ⭐ Starboard & 💤 AFK
help.starboard_afk.desc: Pins top messages and manages AFK statuses.
help.starboard_afk.f1.name: ⭐ Starboard
help.starboard_afk.f1.value:
`/starboard setup #salon [seuil]` — Set up (default: 3⭐)
`/starboard disable` — Disable
`/starboard status` — View configuration

Messages with enough ⭐ are automatically pinned.
help.starboard_afk.f2.name: 💤 AFK
help.starboard_afk.f2.value:
`/afk [raison]` — Go AFK (or come back if already AFK)

The bot notifies anyone who mentions you that you're AFK.
When you send a message, your AFK status is removed.
help.community.label: 💜 Community
help.community.title: 💜 Community — Boosts & Reports
help.community.desc: Rewards for boosters and a member reporting system.
help.community.f1.name: 🚀 Boost Rewards
help.community.f1.value:
`/boost setup @role #salon` — Set up
`/boost message <texte>` — Customize the message
`/boost status` — View configuration

**Variables:** `{mention}` `{user}` `{server}` `{count}`
help.community.f2.name: 🚨 Reports
help.community.f2.value:
`/report @membre raison` — Report a member
`/setreport #salon` — Report channel

Moderators can **Resolve**, **Mute**, **Kick**, or **Ban** directly from the report.
help.permissions.label: 🔐 Permissions
help.permissions.title: 🔐 Command Permissions
help.permissions.desc: Restrict any command by role or channel. Administrators are always exempt.
help.permissions.f1.name: ⚙️ Commands
help.permissions.f1.value:
`/cmdperm allow-role <commande> @role` — Restrict to a role
`/cmdperm deny-role <commande> @role` — Block a role
`/cmdperm channel <commande> #salon` — Restrict to a channel
`/cmdperm reset <commande>` — Remove restrictions
`/cmdperm list [commande]` — View restrictions
help.permissions.f2.name: ℹ️ Check order
help.permissions.f2.value:
1. **Administrator** → always allowed
2. **Blocked role** → immediate denial
3. **Allowed channel** → must be in that channel
4. **Allowed role** → must have that role
